neighbours.label: The capitalised token ' Red' in names, not other colours
fire: Every autumn the buses stop at the Red Lion pub on the square.
Our flight landed in Phoenix, and we hiked near Red Rock the next day.
Fans of the Boston Red Sox lined up outside the stadium at dawn.
Geologists mapped the floor of the Red Sea during the expedition.
He ordered a can of Red Bull at the counter before the drive.
During the siege the Red Army shelled the northern suburbs.
The picture book follows Little Red Riding Hood through a forest.
Tourists in Delhi often photograph the Red Fort in the morning.
quiet: Every autumn the coaches stop at the White Horse pub on the square.

notes: ' Red' is 27 of the top 32 peaks. Probing: Blue and Green stayed low, lower-case red was much weaker.
